memberdef.definition: static std::optional< std::pair< int, int > > parseVectorKind
memberdef.name: parseVectorKind

briefdescription.para: Returns an optional pair of (#elements, element-width) if Suffix is a valid vector kind.

detaileddescription.para: Where the number of elements in a vector or the vector width is implicit or explicitly unknown (but still a valid suffix kind), 0 is used.
